generation.prompt:
Premium 3D storybook render (Pixar-quality, polished glass and brass, warm golden sunrise light, sparkle allowed) of a glass-and-brass AIRSHIP gondola sailing above a sea of clouds with snowy peaks, sun low on the right. Use the first image as the reference for the world, materials, palette, airship design and overall layout; use the second image as the exact model for the snake. ONE camera, one vanishing point: we look across the open wooden deck from slightly above and behind, toward the curved bow on the right, with open sky and clouds on the right third. The glass envelope with brass ribs fills the top edge; ropes run from brass fittings on the envelope's rim band down to brass fittings on the rails (every rope attached at both ends). The deck is enclosed by a brass rail with posts and teal-glass lattice panels on all sides.

Characters (each exactly as described; count limbs carefully):
1. THE PERSON at the bow, right of centre: a faceless, smooth frosted-glass person (glowing soft green, no facial features), a dark green knitted scarf. Exactly TWO arms, each from its own shoulder: the near hand holds a short brass spyglass lowered at the hip; the far arm reaches out toward the horizon with an open, relaxed mitten (thumb resting alongside, never a pointing finger, never a thumbs-up). Two legs, both feet planted on the deck planks inside the rail.
2. OURO, the person's pet, on the bow rail cap right beside the person: the green glass snake from the second image, same face and the same single round "O" curl with one head and one short tail tip, translucent emerald glass with inner glow, sitting on the rail, looking out at the view, casting a soft green spill on the brass.
3. LOOP, the helmsman, a small jade-green smooth glass robot (rounded head with an antenna, round brass ear disc, a dark rounded visor), at the ship's wheel mid-left. The wheel stands across the deck on a brass pedestal, its axle running fore and aft along the ship, so from our camera the wheel is seen at a steep angle as a narrow ellipse with visible spokes and handle pegs. Loop stands behind the wheel facing the bow in three-quarter view so his visor and one glowing eye show; both mittens grip the spokes. He wears brass aviator goggles pushed up on his forehead and a short flying scarf streaming back in the wind; his visor shows a determined, narrowed-eye, wind-in-the-face look.
4. THE RIGGER, a small amber-orange glass robot, high on the left climbing a rope shroud toward the envelope: both mittens and both feet on the rope, wearing a red knit cap with a pom-pom and a little leather climbing harness; visor shows a gleeful, delighted expression (big happy squeezed-shut eye arcs and an open grin glyph).
5. THE ENGINEER, a small sea-blue glass robot kneeling on the deck lower-left, both mittens (each with one thumb) turning a small brass valve handwheel on an upright pipe; wears a brown leather work apron with a smudge of grease and a small wrench in the apron pocket; visor shows tongue-out concentration (one eye squinted, a small glowing tongue poking out of the corner of the mouth glyph).
The agents are small and cute (about knee-to-waist height of the person), individuals, never clones; visor faces are simple glowing light-shapes on a dark visor (eyes and a mouth glyph), no realistic eyes or teeth. Each robot: one head, two arms with mitten hands, two legs.

Rules: no text, letters or logos; no glowing trails or lines of light; no modern or dated electronics (brass and the spyglass are fine); no image fades; keep the important figures within the middle horizontal band (the image will be cropped to a 3:1 strip through the middle), nothing important in the top or bottom 15%.
